001package org.clafer.ast.analysis;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004import java.util.Map;
005import java.util.Optional;
006import java.util.Stack;
007import org.clafer.ast.AstChildRelation;
008import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
009import org.clafer.ast.AstConcreteClafer;
010import org.clafer.ast.AstConstant;
011import org.clafer.ast.AstConstraint;
012import org.clafer.ast.AstExpr;
013import org.clafer.ast.AstJoin;
014import org.clafer.ast.AstJoinParent;
015import org.clafer.ast.AstJoinRef;
016import org.clafer.ast.AstMembership;
017import org.clafer.ast.AstSetTest;
018import org.clafer.ast.AstThis;
019import org.clafer.collection.Pair;
020
021/**
022 *
023 * @author jimmy
024 */
025public class InverseAnalyzer implements Analyzer {
026
027    private static boolean isZero(AstConstant constant) {
028        return constant.value().length == 1 && constant.value()[0].length == 1 && constant.value()[0][0] == 0;
029    }
030
031    private static boolean refTypeIsUnique(AstClafer clafer, Analysis analysis) {
032        return clafer.hasRef() && (clafer.getRef().isUnique()
033                || (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer && analysis.getCard((AstConcreteClafer) clafer).getHigh() == 1));
034    }
035
036    private static boolean thisJoinParent(AstExpr expr, Analysis analysis) {
037        return expr instanceof AstJoinParent && ((AstJoinParent) expr).children() instanceof AstThis
038                || (expr instanceof AstConstant && isZero((AstConstant) expr) && analysis.getScope(((AstConstant) expr).type().getClaferType()) == 1);
039    }
040
041    private static Optional<Pair<AstClafer, AstClafer>> thisJoinRefJoinChildJoinRef(AstExpr expr, Analysis analysis) {
042        if (expr instanceof AstJoinRef) {
043            AstJoinRef set = (AstJoinRef) expr;
044
045            if (refTypeIsUnique(analysis.getType(set.deref()).getClaferType(), analysis)) {
046                AstClafer type1 = analysis.getType(set.deref()).getClaferType();
047                if (set.deref() instanceof AstJoin) {
048                    AstJoin join = (AstJoin) set.deref();
049                    if (join.left() instanceof AstJoinRef && join.right() instanceof AstChildRelation) {
050                        AstJoinRef joinRef = (AstJoinRef) join.left();
051
052                        if (joinRef.deref() instanceof AstThis && refTypeIsUnique(analysis.getType(joinRef.deref()).getClaferType(), analysis)) {
053                            AstClafer type2 = analysis.getType(joinRef.deref()).getClaferType();
054                            return Optional.of(new Pair<>(type1, type2));
055                        }
056                    }
057                }
058            }
059        }
060        return Optional.empty();
061    }
062
063    @Override
064    public Analysis analyze(Analysis analysis) {
065        Stack<Pair<AstClafer, AstClafer>> direction = new Stack<>();
066        Map<AstClafer, AstClafer> inverses = new HashMap<>();
067
068        for (AstConstraint constraint : analysis.getConstraints()) {
069            AstExpr expr = analysis.getExpr(constraint);
070
071            if (expr instanceof AstMembership) {
072                AstMembership membership = (AstMembership) expr;
073                if (membership.op().equals(AstMembership.Op.In)) {
074                    if (thisJoinParent(membership.member(), analysis)) {
075                        thisJoinRefJoinChildJoinRef(membership.set(), analysis).ifPresent(direction::add);
076                    }
077                }
078            } else if (expr instanceof AstSetTest) {
079                AstSetTest setTest = (AstSetTest) expr;
080                if (setTest.op().equals(AstSetTest.Op.Equal)) {
081                    if (thisJoinParent(setTest.left(), analysis)) {
082                        thisJoinRefJoinChildJoinRef(setTest.right(), analysis).ifPresent(direction::add);
083                    } else if (thisJoinParent(setTest.right(), analysis)) {
084                        thisJoinRefJoinChildJoinRef(setTest.left(), analysis).ifPresent(direction::add);
085                    }
086                }
087            }
088        }
089        while (!direction.isEmpty()) {
090            Pair<AstClafer, AstClafer> d = direction.pop();
091            if (direction.remove(new Pair<>(d.getSnd(), d.getFst()))) {
092                if (inverses.put(d.getFst(), d.getSnd()) != null) {
093                    throw new IllegalStateException("Unexpected two inverse relationships for " + d.getFst());
094                }
095                if (inverses.put(d.getSnd(), d.getFst()) != null) {
096                    throw new IllegalStateException("Unexpected two inverse relationships for " + d.getSnd());
097                }
098            }
099        }
100        return analysis.setInverseMap(inverses);
101    }
102}
